en: Convoy raid

?context: Operation briefing in orders format (situation, mission, execution); numbers come from the spec data
en: Situation: a Combine convoy of 3 or 4 bulk carriers and tankers is due through this water under a destroyer escort, and a coastal submarine waits along its route. Mission: sink or disable 60% of its tonnage. Execution: close unseen, strike the merchants and break off before the escort can pin you. Keep the hull sonar listening. A raided lane stays cut for 10 days and patrols thin across the region.

?context: Template operation name on the chart table
en: Depot strike

?context: Operation briefing in orders format (situation, mission, execution); numbers come from the spec data
en: Situation: the depot hulk moored here holds fuel and munitions for the region's groups. A harbour garrison guards her and a gun frigate group lies close by. Mission: destroy the depot. Execution: come in from seaward, fire on the hulk and withdraw. An empty depot cuts every lane it feeds for 10 days.

en: Radar decapitation

?context: Operation briefing in orders format (situation, mission, execution); numbers come from the spec data
en: Situation: this radar site fills the Combine's picture of the straits. A garrison and an anti-submarine group cover it. Mission: destroy the site. Execution: approach under emission control, then engage it with guns or missiles, or land a party by boat. Get clear before the group can close.

en: Agent extraction

?context: Operation briefing in orders format (situation, mission, execution); numbers come from the spec data
en: Situation: 4 of our people are waiting at the landing on this island. A patrol covers the shore and a gun frigate group is within reach. Mission: bring all 4 aboard alive. Execution: hold within 100 m of the landing under 3 kn for 60 s while the boat goes in, then leave by the exit.

?context: Template operation name on the chart table
en: Minelaying

?context: Operation briefing in orders format (situation, mission, execution); numbers come from the spec data
en: Situation: this lane carries the Combine's traffic between its yards and bases. A heavy patrol works it, a coastal submarine guards it and a missile group is nearby. Mission: lay 8 mines across the lane. Execution: draw the line on the plot table and hold its course at 6 kn or more. A laid field cuts the lane.

en: Prize capture

?context: Operation briefing in orders format (situation, mission, execution); numbers come from the spec data
en: Situation: 1 or 2 merchants are passing under a destroyer escort. Mission: stop one and take her. Execution: disable her propulsion, come within 200 m under 5 kn and hold for 90 s while the boarding team works. Either ship taking fire aborts the capture. A prize brought home pays more than a wreck.

?context: Template operation name on the chart table
en: Defector escort

?context: Operation briefing in orders format (situation, mission, execution); numbers come from the spec data
en: Situation: an island packet carrying 6 yard workers who have walked out of the Combine is making for the rendezvous. She is neutral until she reaches it. A gun frigate group is in pursuit. Mission: bring the packet to the exit. Execution: meet her, take off her people or screen her, and lose the pursuit. We can afford to lose 1 of them.

?context: Template operation name on the chart table
en: Feint

?context: Operation briefing in orders format (situation, mission, execution); numbers come from the spec data
en: Situation: a raid elsewhere needs this region's gun frigate group looking the wrong way. Mission: be seen, hold its attention for 5 minutes, then escape. Execution: let them detect you, keep the range open with decoys and drones, and run before they close. A submarine may come up behind them.

?context: Template operation name on the chart table
en: Photo reconnaissance

?context: Operation briefing in orders format (situation, mission, execution); numbers come from the spec data
en: Situation: the Combine has built submarine pens on this shore. A garrison lies off them with a coastal boat, and an anti-submarine group patrols nearby. Mission: photograph 3 of the ships at the pens. Execution: hold each target in the camera's 10° field of view, within 6 km and in sight, for 20 s. Stay unseen.

?context: Template operation name on the chart table
en: Hunter group

?context: Operation briefing in orders format (situation, mission, execution); numbers come from the spec data
en: Situation: a hunter group has found SEXTANT's cove, and submarines are waiting off the exit. This operation cannot be declined. Mission: survive 15 minutes and leave by the exit. Execution: use emission control, decoys and drones to break contact; fight only to clear the way out.

en: Cutting out

?context: Operation briefing in orders format (situation, mission, execution); numbers come from the spec data
en: Situation: a merchant lies at her berth in this harbour under a garrison, with a gun frigate group outside. Mission: take her and sail her out. Execution: slip in under 4 m of draft, board her at the berth and bring her to the exit under her own Helm officer.

en: The Saltby lighter

?context: Operation briefing in orders format (situation, mission, execution); numbers come from the spec data
en: Situation: the bulk carrier that brought the Hollin yard its new 155 mm mounts lies at her berth in Saltby, waiting to unload. A garrison holds the harbour and a gun frigate group lies outside. Mission: cut her out. Execution: slip in under 4 m of draft, board her and sail her to the exit. Her cargo carries the drawings for the heavy guns.

?context: Operation name (proper noun)
en: Greywater

?context: Operation briefing in orders format (situation, mission, execution); numbers come from the spec data
en: Situation: the boats from the Hollin yard reach open water through the Greywater channel, and a pack is on patrol in it now. A heavy patrol and an anti-submarine group cover the channel. Mission: lay 10 mines across it. Execution: listen before you move, then draw the line and hold its course. The Actuary is expected to join them.

?context: Operation name (proper noun)
en: The Vell engineers

?context: Operation briefing in orders format (situation, mission, execution); numbers come from the spec data
en: Situation: 6 engineers from the Hollin yard know when the Liquidator's cruiser sails. They are waiting at the landing below Vell depot. A patrol covers the shore and a gun frigate group is within reach. Mission: bring them aboard. Execution: hold at the landing while the boat goes in, then leave by the exit. We can afford to lose 1 of them.

?context: Operation name (proper noun)
en: Strand bunkers

?context: Operation briefing in orders format (situation, mission, execution); numbers come from the spec data
en: Situation: the fleet tankers that will fuel Foreclosure for her first patrol are crossing the Spindle under a destroyer escort, with a coastal boat ahead of them. Mission: sink or disable 75% of their tonnage. Execution: strike the tankers and break off. The Liquidator is expected to come out for them.

?context: Operation name (proper noun)
en: Expected loss

?context: Operation briefing in orders format (situation, mission, execution); numbers come from the spec data
en: Situation: the Actuary's ship, Contingency, is hunting this water with an anti-submarine group and a pack of boats. She finds targets by plot and strikes from far off. Mission: sink or disable Contingency. Execution: deny her a plot, deal with the boats and close on her. Taken intact she is worth more.

?context: Operation name (proper noun)
en: Receivership

?context: Operation briefing in orders format (situation, mission, execution); numbers come from the spec data
en: Situation: the Liquidator's cruiser, Foreclosure, is at sea with a gun frigate group. Her 155 mm turrets reach 18 km, and she keeps 16 km in rain with her radar off. Mission: sink or disable Foreclosure. Execution: stock officers will close into her guns waiting to identify her; set the ship to fire from range and dodge her salvoes.

?context: Operation name (proper noun)
en: The Hollin slipways

?context: Operation briefing in orders format (situation, mission, execution); numbers come from the spec data
en: Situation: the Hollin yard builds the Combine's cruisers and submarines, and its depot fuels the straits. A heavy task group lies off the slipways with a garrison and a coastal boat, strike aircraft are 5 minutes out and a missile group 10. Mission: destroy the depot. Execution: strike fast and get clear before the second wave arrives. This ends the Combine's hold on the straits.
